description:
Install and launch the WebDriverAgent (WDA) app on a booted iOS simulator using the app path from setup_wda.
      This tool requires WDA to be already set up using setup_wda and at least one simulator to be booted.

appPath.description:
The path to the WDA app bundle (.app file) that be generated by setup_wda tool.
          If not provided, will try to find the latest cached WDA app.

simulatorUdid.description: The UDID of the simulator to install WDA on. If not provided, will use the first booted simulator found.

name: install_wda
